meal.title: Checking Digits and Converting Types
meal.objective: Verify a string is numeric with isdigit and convert it to an integer

voice.script: Is your input really a number? When you ask the player for a deposit, you need to be sure they typed digits only. Python strings have a method called isdigit that looks at every character and returns true if each one is a numeral. If the check passes, you can turn the text into a real number using the int function, which builds an integer from the characters. Let’s see it in action.
